specs.instructions: The test suite exits 0.
Every module under src, adapters and bin compiles.
README.md is at most 100 lines.
No unit test calls fetch(); the suite must never hit the live API.
No TODO, FIXME or XXX comment is left in shipped source.
Every fixture is labelled in calibrate.ts; an unlabelled one silently defaults to should-pass.
The working tree is clean: this turn's work is committed.
Every docs/*.txt referenced by llms.txt exists.
Every judgment spec carries a fitted band; deterministic ones need none.
Every `require` in .orly/specs.json is an object with a string path and a known op.
Every spec in .orly/specs.json passes validateSpecs and evaluates without throwing, so the Stop hook cannot fail open on it.
No pi tool-index or pi goal-state file is tracked by git.
README.md draws the owl exactly once.
